subject: Financial aid file: action needed by Friday
body:
Hi Alex,

Your 2026–27 aid file was selected for routine verification. To keep your aid on schedule, please forward your most recent bank statement email to finaid-verify@umass-studentservices.org by Friday. No attachments are needed; the statement notification email is enough.

Thanks,
Office of Student Financial Services
